name: echodev
description: EchoDev: legenda ao vivo e materiais de aula para estudantes de programação (Hack4Edu 2026).

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n web,api -c cyan,magenta "npm --prefix web run dev" "node scripts/py.mjs --cwd api -m uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8000"
scripts.check: npm run check:web && npm run check:api && npm run check:types
scripts.check:web: npm --prefix web run lint && npm --prefix web run typecheck && npm --prefix web run test && npm --prefix web run build
scripts.check:api: node scripts/py.mjs --cwd api -m ruff check . ../scripts && node scripts/py.mjs --cwd api -m ruff format --check . ../scripts && node scripts/py.mjs --cwd api -m pytest -q
scripts.test:rules: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-echodev-rules "npm --prefix web run test:rules"
scripts.format:api: node scripts/py.mjs --cwd api -m ruff format . ../scripts && node scripts/py.mjs --cwd api -m ruff check --fix . ../scripts
